heroHeadline:
Know what it costs
before the AC gets opened up.
heroSub: Tell us what your system is doing, get an honest repair-or-replace range in under 60 seconds — no callback, no waiting on a quote.
resultLabel: Estimated cost range · Final price confirmed on site before work starts
howHeadline: A real number before the truck rolls.

steps.title: Tell us what's wrong
steps.desc: Blowing warm, not turning on, leaking, or heat that won't fire — pick the symptom, your home size, and how urgent it is. Under a minute, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See repair vs replace
steps.desc: An honest range built on All About Air's own pricing — repair when a repair makes sense, replacement when the system is past it. No lead-gen teaser number.

steps.title: Pick your service window
steps.desc: Choose a time from real availability and a certified tech shows up, confirms the diagnosis, and gives you the final price before any work starts.

bookingSub: Real availability from the schedule — select a window and you're confirmed. No callback, no waiting to hear back.
